name: enterClass
description: CSS class added to the host element when it enters the viewport.

name: leaveClass
description: CSS class added to the host element when it leaves the viewport.

name: rootMargin
description: IntersectionObserver rootMargin option controlling viewport detection bounds.

name: threshold
description: Intersection ratio threshold at which enter and leave classes are toggled.

name: once
description: Disconnects the observer after the first intersection when true.
